programme.title: Authority in Christ Bible Study Guide Day 2 Authority to Bind and Loose
programme.desc:
blessed2teachcombible
Prayer Guide Day 2 I will use the authority Christ has given me to bindforbid and to allowloose through my prayers Matthew 1818 Truly I say to you whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven and whatever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven Father I bind the rulers and authorities and powers of this dark world trying to take your children off their paths and I loose angels of all rankings and divisions to help us stay on our path In the name of Jesus Amen
Context In Matthew 1818 Jesus gives us the authority to bind and loose on earth and it will be done in heaven Let’s explore the meaning of these terms Bind = ForbidDisallow Loosing = PermitAllow These terms were used by Jewish scribes to forbid or permit items when interpreting scripture To better understand the meaning of this authority we will discuss Matthew 1810-20 where Jesus starts with a parable Jesus emphasizes the value of each individual particularly the vulnerable and illustrates Gods care through parables of angels and lost sheep Angels in Heaven Jesus highlights that the angels of children always have direct access to God indicating their special protection and value Other scriptures talk about us have specific angels assigned to us Acts 1214-15 Recognizing Peters voice in her joy she did not open the gate but ran in and reported that Peter was standing at the gate They said to her “You are out of your mind” But she kept insisting that it was so and they kept saying “It is his angel!” httpswwwbiblegatewaycompassagesearch=Acts20123A14-15version=ESV Notice “his angel” confirming they believed Peter had an angel assigned to him Parable of the Lost Sheep He uses the analogy of a shepherd leaving 99 sheep to find one thats lost showcasing the joy and dedication to retrieving the one who has gone astray God’s Will God does not desire any of these little ones to be lost emphasizing divine love and care for each individual God deeply cares for everyone especially those who are at risk or in need It shows that God is overjoyed when someone who has strayed comes back highlighting the value of redemption and return Jesus then outlines a process for resolving personal conflicts with steps to hopefully result in this redemption and return of the sinner Private Discussion First address the issue directly with the person who wronged you aiming for reconciliation This is vital and likely will be very healthy for any Christian community as conflicts are often resolved quickly without escalation Witnesses If they dont listen involve one or two others to mediate and confirm the situation Most would consider these neutral witnesses with Godly wisdom not an advocate Jesus continues the requirements from the law established in Deuteronomy Deuteronomy 1915 A single witness shall not suffice against a person for any crime or for any wrong in connection with any offense that he has committed Only on the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses shall a charge be established httpswwwbiblegatewaycompassagesearch=Deuteronomy20193A15version=ESV All the more reason for neutral witnesses as often the accuser is misunderstanding or even the one in sin Involve the Church If they still dont listen bring the matter before the church community for resolution Jesus wants transparency not hiding conflicts Final Action If they refuse to heed the churchs advice treat them as outsiders akin to how Gentiles or tax collectors were treated in that era This would indicate a form of separation or excommunication This approach prioritizes personal reconciliation but provides for community involvement if necessary Next Jesus teaches that actions taken on earth have spiritual consequences in heaven and communal agreement in prayer has power Binding and Loosing Actions to bind or loose on earth will correspondingly affect heaven Matthew 1618-19 And I tell you you are Peter and on this rock I will build my church and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven and whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven and whatever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven” httpswwwbiblegatewaycompassagesearch=Matthew20163A18-19version=ESV Agreement in Prayer If two people agree on something in prayer their request will be granted by God Presence in Gathering Jesus promises His presence among even the smallest gatherings in His name Think about that If we bind or loose here on earth it will be done in heaven if we come together in prayer his presence is with us and if we come to agreement in prayer the Father hears us That is authority! Our authority in Christ is great so let’s take advantage of it!
Matthew 1810-20 Read the full context of God’s word here httpswwwbiblegatewaycompassage
